title: SEED-family annulus draw duplicated verbatim in two branches of growth_plan_demand
evidence:
growth.odin:694-703 (no-eligible-cluster branch):
				seed_attempt = true
				router_slot := growth_junction_slot_at(t, rng_range(rng, 0, i32(nj) - 1))
				dir := growth_dir_pick(rng)
				lo := GROWTH_OUT_MIN_TILES
				hi := span
				if lo > hi {
					lo = hi // degenerate span guard — the draw stays in [0, span]
				}
				dist := rng_range(rng, lo, hi)
				pos = t.node_pos[router_slot] + dir * dist
growth.odin:714-723 (coin-miss branch) — byte-identical body:
			seed_attempt = true
			router_slot := growth_junction_slot_at(t, rng_range(rng, 0, i32(nj) - 1))
			dir := growth_dir_pick(rng)
			lo := GROWTH_OUT_MIN_TILES
			hi := span
			if lo > hi {
				lo = hi // degenerate span guard — the draw stays in [0, span]
			}
			dist := rng_range(rng, lo, hi)
			pos = t.node_pos[router_slot] + dir * dist
detail: This PR names both branches one family ('SEED') yet had to edit each identically (adding seed_attempt=true) — the touch itself shows the drift risk. A future draw tweak applied to one branch only would silently diverge strict vs opt-in seeds.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared proc (e.g. growth_seed_draw(t, rng, nj, span) -> [2]i32) called from both branches; identical draws by construction, draw order unchanged.

title: growth_attach_radius_ok takes ^Topology + slot but is a pure two-point distance test
detail: Unlike siblings (growth_seed_sep_ok, growth_node_sep_ok) which scan the topology, this reads only node_pos[anchor_slot]. The slot coupling forces test_growth_attach_radius_predicate to build a full Run_State fixture for a pure distance check.
recommended_fix: Change signature to (anchor, pos: [2]i32, radius: i32); pass t.node_pos[anchor_slot] at the call site. Predicate becomes pure and unit-testable without a topology.
